issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B, ToQuantity and ToString conversion operators
issues.evidence: Translated Patient-context CQL with define Q: ToQuantity('5 ''mg'''); define QS: ToString(Q); define QC: convert Q to String returned internal Quantity JSON {'value':5,'unit':'mg',...} on both native-loaded and forced Python fallback DuckDB. Expected CQL Quantity string representation is 5.0 'mg'. Same issue reproduced when Q came from function MakeQuantity(S): ToQuantity(S).
issues.root_cause: CQL type inference did not classify conversion functions such as ToQuantity/ToRatio/ToConcept/ToLong or user-defined function calls by their inlined body type, so Quantity conversion definitions were metadata-classified as resource-shaped and later ToString routing lacked Quantity evidence.
issues.resolution: Inferred semantic return types for conversion functions and user-defined function bodies, kept scalar conversion CTEs on value columns, routed statically known Quantity ToString through QuantityToString, and added population SQL parity coverage for direct and function-inlined Quantity aliases.
